purpose: Central registry for material runner-dependent tasks. Default eligible work is accumulated and deduplicated for one final consolidated runner batch instead of being repeatedly executed during normal development.
authorization_rule: Benchmark registration never grants execution authority. Any owner/runtime/destructive/provider/deploy/release gated item remains BLOCKED_AUTHORIZATION, including during the final batch. Consumed, expired or unrelated grants are never reused.

final_batch.trigger: Milestone/integration closeout after normal implementation is settled and before terminal milestone/release claims.
entry_conditions: all non-runner implementation intended for the batch is integrated or frozen
each task has a stable dedup_key and current authorization state
security/merge/safety exceptions have already run when required
blocked-authorization tasks remain excluded rather than inferred executable
final_batch.deduplication: Tasks with equivalent workflow/command + exact source + environment/matrix + fixture/input identity collapse to one execution record; dependents reference the same evidence.
exit_conditions: all executable entries have terminal evidence
failures are classified and not hidden by rerun-until-green
blocked authorization items remain explicitly blocked
evidence IDs/digests and source SHA are recorded
benchmark statuses are reconciled before milestone closeout
